title: Minimax Risk for Sentinel Contrasts When Assignment Precedes Recruitment in Cluster Trials
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded the sound package incremental, below the field floor (paper-score ceiling 6.1 versus 7.4), and found no bounded field-tier repair.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 discharged the scalar conditional minimax risk, matching-attainment frontier, quantitative converse, and exact wedge-union high-yield frontier; the math referee passed without findings. D0.5 graded the sound package incremental with a 6.1 paper-score ceiling below the 7.4 field threshold and no bounded in-scope rescue. A full arbitrary-forest frontier would require a new optimization and dual-certificate program; three decision-referee positioning and ballast findings remain for any future lower-tier presentation.
tldr: Assignment precedes recruitment, so the complete sentinel roster changes the randomization information available for each directional sentinel contrast. The project reduces every recruited-sentinel decision problem to the exact scalar value \(R_\star(s)\), then proves that the expected sum of these roster-conditional risks is at least \(3/8\) of expected recruitment. Equality holds exactly for matching-supported gate schedules, randomized matchings attain every yield through \(3\nu_0/4\), and a line-graph converse forces positive excess above capacity. On disjoint unions of two-edge paths, an explicit convex-envelope formula gives the exact frontier at every feasible yield, with attaining overlapping-gate schedules and a matching lower certificate.
gap: Recruitment papers distinguish recruited from overall populations, selective-randomization papers establish conditional validity, and network-design papers optimize unconditional precision for always-observed outcomes. None of the inspected theorem statements optimizes an OR recruitment channel for a risk guarantee delivered separately to every sentinel selected by every realized roster.
fill: The scalar minimax reduction supplies the exact local cost; Jensen equality and a collision covariance identify matching schedules as the complete zero-excess class; randomized schedules attain the full low-yield frontier; and the quantitative converse prices recruitment above matching capacity.
